summary: Independent verification of the 3 security-audit fixes (SEC-001 WhatsApp webhook fail-closed, SEC-002 admin OTP no plaintext + subject without code, SEC-003 HTML escaping in transactional emails) plus P3 hardenings (tracking-code enumeration and WA bot surname verification) and regression of core money/application flows. Built /app/backend/tests/test_security_audit_fixes.py with 12 tests, all 12 pass. Frontend verified: /admin/whatsapp Bot Ayarları tab shows the new amber warning block with exact text 'App Secret girilmedi.', wa-field-app-secret and wa-settings-save-button both render, no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: wa_cloud.verify_signature fail-closed behaviour is correct (returns False when app_secret is empty); GET verify_webhook correctly uses hmac.compare_digest for the verify token.
routes_admin.admin_request_code now $unset code_plain on every write and stores only code_hash; subject is the constant 'Yönetici giriş kodunuz' with no code leak - verified.
emailer.esc() is used in every user-controlled interpolation observed (contact fields, travelers table, admin_notify_html, contact_admin_html, order_* templates, cart reminders, visa_ready).
routes_public._find_application_for_tracking returns a single generic 404 message 'Takip kodu ve soyad bilgisi eslesmiyor.' for both unknown code and surname mismatch - confirmed.

wa_bot.application_status_text requires phone_ok OR surname_ok; when only ref code + random phone is sent, it responds with the verification prompt - confirmed via /api/admin/whatsapp/ai/simulate/message.
routes_whatsapp._webhook_rate_ok exists (120 events / 60s in-memory sliding window); helper logic is straightforward and does not block normal calls - verified by successful subsequent test posts.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 throwaway applications (reference codes with last_names DELIVERED, HARDENING, SURNAMEZ, REGRESSION) and 1 eSIM order; each test deletes its own rows from db.applications, db.email_outbox, db.orders, db.contact_messages, db.conversations before/after. No residual TEST_* data left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_security_audit_fixes.py is a reusable regression suite. It requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, MONGO_URL, DB_NAME env vars (pytest inherits shell env). All 12 tests currently green. The test that requires the admin OTP flow first cleans db.admin_login_codes for ADMIN_LOGIN_EMAIL to bypass the 60s cooldown; do the same if re-running back-to-back.
rca of the issue: N/A - verification-only pass; all 3 audit findings are correctly remediated. One initial test-side issue: assertion checked for a 'pack_family' key inside bundle items, but pack_family is actually a bundle ID (items list contains an object with id='pack_family'); assertion was corrected to check id membership.
